title: NANSEN fragment
description: A named group of columns that can be added to an entity type, for example notes, progress or a user's own table variables. A fragment has its own version: a table records which version of each fragment its columns follow.

version.description: Version of this fragment's definition, independent of schemaVersion.

compute.description: Makes the fragment computed: the method (serial, on the fragment's entity type) returns a struct/dict with a value per column, and updating the fragment writes them to the table. NANSEN's table variables.

default.description: Value given to existing rows when the fragment is added, and to new rows. Dates and datetimes are written as in the CSV format.

choices.description: For a string column: the values it may take (besides none). The app edits it with a list, and the API refuses other values. The CSV is read as written.

display.description: How the dashboard draws the column's cells, as dev's table variable renderers: progress (a bar for a number from 0 to 1), badge (the value as a coloured label), or link (a web address).

action.description: A method run on the row when one of the column's cells is double-clicked in the dashboard, as dev's table variable double-click functions.
